extensionDescription.message: A calm, accessible look that makes reading, selecting and deleting mail easier. The selected card turns into transparent glass, and every card has its own Junk and Delete buttons.

optionsIntro.message: Changes apply immediately; there is no need to restart Thunderbird.

accentHelp.message: Used for the edge of the selected card, the unread dot and the focus ring. Every option meets the contrast threshold in light and dark mode.

deleteLegend.message: Junk and Delete buttons on cards

deleteHover.message: Show on the selected card and on mouse hover

deleteHelp.message: Delete moves the message to the Trash with Thunderbird's own Delete command (the Delete key does the same). Junk marks the message as junk (J key); on a junk message the same button removes the mark (Shift+J). Whether junk is also moved to the Junk folder depends on Thunderbird's Privacy & Security settings.

glassLabel.message: Glass effect and ambient light on the selected card

glassHelp.message: When turned off, the selected card uses a flat, solid color.

spacingHelp.message: When turned off, Thunderbird's default card spacing is used and more messages fit on screen.

a11yNote.message: When a Windows contrast theme is active, Kristal steps aside and Thunderbird's accessible colors are used. When "reduce motion" is on, transitions are turned off.
